segments.text: Ben Franklin once said, by failing to prepare, you are preparing to fail.
segments.zh: 本·富兰克林曾经说过：不做准备，就是在准备失败。

segments.text: It's vital that you prepare for each lab activity.
segments.zh: 为每一项实验活动做好准备是至关重要的。

segments.text: Before you begin, determine the possible risks,
segments.zh: 开始之前，先确定可能存在的风险，

segments.text: wear the right PPE, and be aware of any protective measures
segments.zh: 穿戴合适的个人防护装备，并了解所有防护措施

segments.text: and emergency responses that are pertinent for the chemicals that you'll be working with.
segments.zh: 以及与你将要使用的化学品相关的应急处置方法。

segments.text: When diluting acids or bases, always add the acid or the base to the solvent,
segments.zh: 稀释酸或碱时，一定要把酸或碱加入溶剂中，

segments.text: such as water, not the other way around.
segments.zh: 比如水，而不是反过来。

segments.text: Pouring the solvent into an acid or base can cause a violent reaction,
segments.zh: 把溶剂倒入酸或碱中可能会引起剧烈反应，

segments.text: and you may get burned.
segments.zh: 你可能会被烧伤。

segments.text: Never remove chemicals from the lab.
segments.zh: 绝不要把化学品带出实验室。

segments.text: Use a brake-resistant secondary container to transport chemicals between lab spaces.
segments.zh: 在不同实验室空间之间转移化学品时，要使用防破碎的二次容器。

segments.text: Chemicals must be handled safely in order to avoid skin, eye, or inhalation exposure.
segments.zh: 必须安全地处理化学品，以避免皮肤、眼睛接触或吸入暴露。

segments.text: First, let's talk about protecting your eyes.
segments.zh: 首先，我们来谈谈如何保护眼睛。

segments.text: As we mentioned in our lesson about PPE,
segments.zh: 正如我们在个人防护装备那一课中提到的，

segments.text: safety glasses with side shields offer some protection,
segments.zh: 带侧护罩的安全眼镜能提供一定的防护，

segments.text: but they won't help you when working with a potential splash hazard.
segments.zh: 但在有潜在飞溅危险的操作中，它们帮不了你。

segments.text: Splash goggles are more effective at protecting your eyes.
segments.zh: 防溅护目镜保护眼睛的效果更好。

segments.text: Chemical splash goggles should be marked with the code Z87.1.
segments.zh: 化学防溅护目镜上应标有代码 Z87.1。

segments.text: This code indicates compliance with American National Standards Institute.
segments.zh: 这个代码表示符合美国国家标准学会的标准。

segments.text: Prescription glasses don't offer adequate eye protection.
segments.zh: 处方眼镜不能提供足够的眼部防护。

segments.text: Wear safety glasses.
segments.zh: 要戴安全眼镜、

segments.text: Goggles or a full face shield over your prescription glasses.
segments.zh: 护目镜或全面罩，戴在你的处方眼镜外面。

segments.text: Corrosive chemicals will harm you if they splash or come into contact with your skin.
segments.zh: 腐蚀性化学品一旦飞溅或接触到皮肤就会伤害你。

segments.text: A lab coat and gloves will help protect your skin to a degree,
segments.zh: 实验服和手套能在一定程度上保护你的皮肤，

segments.text: but a full-length chemical-resistant lab apron is the best choice when working with splash hazards.
segments.zh: 但在有飞溅危险的操作中，全长的耐化学品实验围裙是最好的选择。

segments.text: If you're working with an especially corrosive chemical,
segments.zh: 如果你使用的是腐蚀性特别强的化学品，

segments.text: use full arm-length rubber gloves instead of the typical nitro gloves.
segments.zh: 要使用长及整条手臂的橡胶手套，而不是普通的丁腈手套。

segments.text: Some chemicals in the lab can harm you without even touching you.
segments.zh: 实验室里有些化学品甚至不用接触你就能伤害你。

segments.text: That's why it's important to be aware of inhalation exposure.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么要注意吸入暴露。

segments.text: Never smell chemicals.
segments.zh: 绝不要去闻化学品。

segments.text: Always work with toxic chemicals under a fume hood,
segments.zh: 处理有毒化学品时一定要在通风柜内操作，

segments.text: and keep containers closed tightly if you're not using them.
segments.zh: 不使用时要把容器盖紧。

segments.text: If a large chemical spill occurs, evacuate, seal off the lab, and notify the authorities.
segments.zh: 如果发生大量化学品泄漏，要撤离、封锁实验室，并通知有关部门。

segments.text: Large spills can produce excessive vapors.
segments.zh: 大量泄漏会产生过多的蒸气。

segments.text: They have to be cleaned by qualified personnel.
segments.zh: 必须由合格的人员来清理。

segments.text: Don't re-enter the lab until your supervisor gives you the all clear.
segments.zh: 在主管宣布解除警报之前，不要重新进入实验室。

segments.text: Flammable chemicals require special handling techniques.
segments.zh: 易燃化学品需要特殊的处理方法。

segments.text: First, always know the flammability and explosive potential for each chemical you're working with.
segments.zh: 首先，一定要了解你所使用的每种化学品的易燃性和爆炸可能性。

segments.text: Keep flammables away from all ignition sources, such as bunts and burners or hot plays.
segments.zh: 让易燃物远离所有点火源，比如本生灯或加热板。

segments.text: Store flammable chemicals in a dedicated and grounded storage cabinet.
segments.zh: 把易燃化学品存放在专用且接地的储存柜中。

segments.text: When you're finished working in the lab, properly dispose of chemicals and waste
segments.zh: 在实验室工作结束后，要按照联邦、州、地方和机构的要求，

segments.text: according to federal, state, local, and institutional requirements.
segments.zh: 妥善处置化学品和废弃物。

segments.text: Use chemical-resistant plastic or metal containers for waste disposal.
segments.zh: 使用耐化学品的塑料或金属容器来处置废弃物。

segments.text: Solvent should never be evaporated under a fume hood as a means of disposal.
segments.zh: 绝不应通过在通风柜中蒸发溶剂的方式来处置它们。

segments.text: Check with your lab supervisor for the best way to evaporate solvents.
segments.zh: 请向你的实验室主管咨询蒸发溶剂的最佳方法。

segments.text: Any materials used to clean up a chemical spill, such as paper towels,
segments.zh: 用于清理化学品泄漏的任何材料，比如纸巾，

segments.text: are also considered hazardous waste and must also be disposed of accordingly.
segments.zh: 也被视为危险废物，同样必须按相应规定处置。

segments.text: Preparation is the key to handling chemicals safely in the lab.
segments.zh: 做好准备是在实验室安全处理化学品的关键。

segments.text: Know what you're working with, how to handle it, and what to do in case of accidental exposure.
segments.zh: 要知道你在用什么、如何处理它，以及发生意外暴露时该怎么做。

segments.text: In our next lesson, we'll talk about a few other common lab hazards that you need to prepare for.
segments.zh: 在下一课中，我们将讨论你需要做好准备应对的其他几种常见实验室危害。
